acceptance: A red-first test through the real window rule: lock wait over the bound gives no widening, and lock wait under the bound gives the old result.
A shadow record shows the window would not widen while the lock wait of the last window is over its bound.
wave status shows the total lock wait of the wave.
fix: Sum fields.wait_ms of the HOST_VERIFY_LOCK_WAIT signals of the last window. Add the sum as a pressure input of the window rule, with a bound in policy data. Do not widen the window while the sum is over its bound. Run it in shadow first and record the would-not-widen decisions.
summary: The host-adaptive window reads CPU and memory only. In wave 185 the host looked idle while 7 of 8 lanes waited at the host verification lock, so the window would add lanes. Each acquire now emits HOST_VERIFY_LOCK_WAIT with fields.wait_ms, source and outcome (plan docs/plans/verify-lock-holder-budget-2026-11.md), but nothing reads it.
title: The host-adaptive fleet window reads the verification lock wait as a pressure input
